TDCS.description: Tendon Location for Composite Section (TDCS). Assigns the tendon profile, the composite section used for the construction stage, and the part number that together locate a tendon within a composite section; the id key is the TDCS entry number.

TDNA.description: Tendon Profile key: the id of the tendon profile (TDNA) whose geometry this entry references.

CSCS.description: Composite Section for Construction Stage key: the id of the composite section (C.S.) that the tendon is located in.

PART_NUM.description: Part Number: the index of the part within the composite section to which the tendon location applies.
